# Vendored dependency

`ethers.umd.min.js` — **ethers.js v6.17.0** (MIT License, © Richard Moore and
contributors), copied unchanged from this repository's own npm dependency
(`node_modules/ethers/dist/ethers.umd.min.js`) so the static front end in
`app/` works with no build step and no CDN — including from GitHub Pages
and from a plain local file server.

To refresh it: `npm install` at the repository root, then copy
`node_modules/ethers/dist/ethers.umd.min.js` over this file.
